text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"This is it—the Shuka Sho...! The final 
jewel of the Triple Tiara!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Gentildonna, right?! She's 
without a doubt the strongest! Isn't she 
gonna set some insane record!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I really want Verxina-chan to do her best! 
I wonder how far up she can climb...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
A showdown between the two rivals who lit 
up this year's Tiara circuit! How will it 
end...? I can't wait!

Kyoto Racecourse buzzed with immense 
excitement. And the one at the center of 
it all, Gentildonna, was alsoâ
(CRACK...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh my.
choice_data_list: Wh-What was that? That sound just now...
Wh-What was that sound just now...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I ended up... crushing the iron ball.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I was only playing around as usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It seems I misjudged my strength. My 
apologies."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Indeed.
choice_data_list: Nervous? Or is it something else...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Exhilaration, most likely.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I know well how to keep things under 
control."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
However, to think that today... things 
would go so horribly wrong.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'm still so naive. It's only beautiful 
when reason triumphs, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I need to calm this down 
before the race.

Playing with that iron ball was a routine 
to control her strength and calm her mind. 
In that case, instead—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Pardon?
choice_data_list: Now, give it all you've got!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...What are you thinking about?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Shamefully, right now... I am unable to 
hold back my strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Do you wish to learn that firsthand? Just 
like that iron ball."

Looking where Gentildonna gestured with 
her chin... I break out in a cold sweat 
seeing the iron ball crushed to 
smithereens. But—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Exposing your weakness is a poor move. If 
you cannot change your mindset, at least 
put on a brave front.

If it means being of help to Gentildonna, 
I'll put on any act of unyielding 
confidence.
choice_data_list: You won't have any trouble, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: *Inhaaaale*...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Very well. Let us shake on it.

Fingertips gently touch, sending a wave of 
tension through the air... Yet if it is 
Gentildonna—if it is the girl whose very 
pride is perfection, then—
(Grip...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So this is nervousness... It's been a 
while since I last felt it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Handling something so fragile takes an 
extraordinary amount of concentration.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to get my feel 
for it back.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...It doesn't seem like she recklessly 
jumped out in front of a running Umamusume 
for no reason."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do not worry. Your resolve will surely be 
rewarded.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you look at the brilliance of today's 
Tiara.
choice_data_list: Of course I believe in you.

text_block_list.text:
The thrill of the race, the confidence in 
victory... Cloaked impeccably in it all, 
she smiles—
choice_data_list:
Anything less than victory is out of the 
question!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
This time, please welcome me with your 
utmost praise.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. I shall be on my way.
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
(...Excitement swirls all around. Yet, it 
will not sweep me away.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh... When someone shows such courage, 
how could I not?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Gentildonna-san.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: You...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I am truly honored. Thank you for noticing 
so quickly.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No... you should be proud of having honed 
yourself to a point where you cannot be 
ignored.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand clearly. I can see 
it—from your posture alone.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
All the effort you've put in, all those 
days... the strength you've built up.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes. Therefore, today I shall—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Why... are you laughing...?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. You were just so adorable...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Thank you for working so hard for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The more you have built up, the greater 
the value of the crown I claim today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I offer my gratitude. Please 
accept it—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Outside the winner's circle, at the place 
where you belong.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Today, the one standing there is you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Pride... confidence... everything that was 
stolen from me. I shall reclaim them 
all—with the Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I have no intention of stealing what's 
yours, nor any interest in it. After all, 
I have no use for it."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What I desire is radiant proof of 
strength... Now, let us begin.
